from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u081/system/state/workspace/programs/task-52e90ac5.py')
s='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for r, c in cells:
        nc = c - (bottom - r)
        if 0 <= nc < w:
            out[r][nc] = grid[r][c]
    return out
'''
